summary: Iteration 14 - Bug fixes for user limit and free trial issues. All tests PASSED. Backend: Admin users endpoint accepts limit=500 (increased from 100), reset-usage endpoint resets analysis count to 0 with proper message, /api/usage returns analyses_remaining, free_limit, and is_subscribed fields. Frontend: Admin panel Users tab loads all users, expanded user view shows Reset Usage button (confirmed clickable with 'Usage reset successfully' toast), Dashboard shows usage banner with progress dots for free users (5/5 free, 'X of 5 free analyses remaining'), Pro badge shows for subscribed users, upgrade button in banner works.

Backend: GET /api/admin/users?limit=500 accepts limit parameter (no 100 cap)
Backend: GET /api/admin/users returns all users (5 users in test environment)
Backend: POST /api/admin/users/{id}/reset-usage returns 200 with message 'Usage reset to 0 — user now has 5 free analyses'
Backend: Reset-usage endpoint requires admin authentication (returns 401/403 without token)
Backend: GET /api/usage returns analyses_remaining field
Backend: GET /api/usage returns free_limit = 5
Backend: GET /api/usage returns is_subscribed field (true for admin, null/false for free users)
Backend: GET /api/usage returns can_analyze field
Backend: GET /api/admin/user/{id} returns user details with usage and subscription info
Frontend: Admin Dashboard loads with all users visible in Users tab
Frontend: Admin Users tab shows 'All (5)' filter with correct count
Frontend: Admin expanded user view shows Reset Usage button
Frontend: Admin Reset Usage button is clickable and calls correct endpoint
Frontend: Admin Reset Usage shows 'Usage reset successfully' toast on success
Frontend: Dashboard shows Pro badge in header for subscribed admin user

Frontend: Dashboard shows '5/5 free' badge in header for free users

/api/usage endpoint returns all required fields including analyses_remaining calculated correctly
